title: Boston Bouldering Project
gap: Exact prices for day pass, punch pass, and memberships not stated
blurb: Located in Somerville, the gym features multi-level bouldering walls, rope climbing, dedicated yoga and group fitness space, weightlifting and cardio equipment, and co-working seating. Guests can climb routes, take yoga and fitness classes, and use strength and conditioning gear. Memberships include access to all Bouldering Project gyms nationwide.
